content: Sampling/sampler pedagogy (MusicRadar, Audeobox, Melodics) treats sample-chopping and pad-mapping as a foundational, practiced instrumental skill (not a shortcut): Ableton Simpler Slice mode auto-detects transients and maps slices to MIDI notes; MPC-style players (e.g. Araabmuzik) treat the pad grid as a drum-like performance instrument requiring muscle-memory practice of logically-mapped sample layouts.
